coordinateTransform.axisConvention: HGSS X increases right/east, Z increases down/south; BDHC format doc uses map-centered coordinates
coordinateTransform.elevation: BDHC fx32 plane-derived Y is retained as candidate; raw object/event Y and raw plane coefficients are preserved; Unity vertical unit/scale requires calibration

limitations: Event Y values and BDHC plane-derived elevations are raw/candidate data; Unity vertical origin and scale must be visually calibrated.
Original map-model section payloads are skipped; only length and SHA-256 are retained. Building model IDs remain raw references without asset resolution.
Script bytecode and message payloads are not exported or semantically decoded.
Header names are symbolic labels from the pinned decomp; every numeric record field in this selected set is independently read from decompressed ROM ARM9.
